notes.content:
Small update with some bug fixes reported by players as well as my own playthroughs.


Fixed a bug where stools were not being used by customers.
Reduced the chance of road closures.
Fixed a bug with one certain avatar having a different player portrait on the staff screen.
Fixed some grammar bugs in the events text.
Aligned some event dollar amounts being reported as slightly incorrect.

C:\Users\NAME\AppData\LocalLow\Creative Storm\Deadwater Saloon\SavedGames

Thanks.

notes.title: October 5th, 2022 - Update (Bounties)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/c27e17b309a7c6bf2f697c6e3896211b62e34859.png

New system added to the game today: bounties. 


Added a new feature today where it can be discovered that a fugitive lives amongst the townspeople - only no one knows who it is (a list of five suspects will be provided). Of course, the townspeople being a rumor-mongering and nervous bunch, you are also a suspect in this - so you must locate the townsperson via your investigation skill and either legally murder or duel them in order to collect the bounty, thereby also clearing your name.


More to come.

notes.title: September 24th, 2022 - Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/9be8c8895ecdd0219d702a20ad07878a4e1d9c56.png

Important update today.


Owner can be assigned a staff position if Show Owner option is selected. Show player set to default at setup screen but for existing games can also be turned on via the options screen. You can assign your owner to a staff job from the Character screen (drop-down in the top-right corner).
Clicking on player or pet movement button toggles it on and off - this is to prevent the movement icon from appearing when using mouse to pan the map
Guns can be equipped to other staffers (smaller guns for servers, prostitutes, croupiers, and piano players while larger caliber firearms can be assigned to bartenders and bouncers).
Cannot regale someone with already maximum opinion
Fixed bug with piano player not moving properly when piano moved
Fixed bug with door deletion - deleting wall above door will now delete door and wall
Fixed bug with cannot afford label showing when building wall over other item


I'll be taking a bit of a rest and then more to come!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/945bd61104e4bcb6f69cab19d64a8f5f36d7c2af.png

notes.title: September 21st, 2022 - Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/a1e492551ca1b40ddfb6d4907cc27de3af3d53b3.png

Another smaller update for today based on player's invaluable feedback and recommendations. 


Optimized UI and removed black bars for 21:9 aspect ratios. Note that the main UI (the left and right boxes) are still in the same spots, but the sliding notifications now work for that resolution without the bars. The bars can be reactivated from the options menu if anyone wishes to have them on.
Fixed a bug with no owners in a business causing events to continually popup. 
Piggies in the pig farm squeal and noise at a significantly reduced rate.
Decreased the height of the elaborate fireplace. 
Fixed bug with Regale rolls sometimes failing at 100%.
Regale rolls only increase opinion by 5 instead of 10.


More to come!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/b7cede3618e23afb4ccbef89513a69f31aa34472.png

NPCs will now use more than one set of stairs now

Fixed front swinging door obstacle to prevent NPCs from clipping through the edge of the wall on one side


More to come!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/362b4b2eeea7c8abe530737f021ff1d1d081b28f.png

notes.title: September 19th, 2022 - Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/c27e17b309a7c6bf2f697c6e3896211b62e34859.png

Two major updates today fixing pathing and NPC table selection. Long day!


Fixed major pathing issue for NPCs due to walls. Previous saves where this was an issue now work properly. Note this does not fix the issue some people are having with NPCs not going upstairs to drink at a table, that one is next, but it does correct many of the problems with pathing being affected by saloons with numerous rooms.
Fixed bug with NPCs not using upstairs tables. This, along with the pathing update from version 1.4.5 should hopefully fix most of the movement issues now. 
Refactored table selection so people will use both upstairs and downstairs tables when choosing (previously, they would look for downstairs tables first and only after none were found search for upstairs tables next).
Split revenue (food, drink, opium, coffee, cigars) into their own line items on the daily cash tooltip
Fixed bug with NPCs sometimes spending $0 in businesses. If you own a business, you will see what they spend each day now in daily cash tooltip.
Fixed a small bug with new town tax system.
Fixed bug with stress modifiers being reversed on game start settings. 
Fixed theater and post office countdown bugs.
Fixed bug with health dropping below 0%.
Fixed bug with stress levels at brutal/mild settings
Added more detail to daily cash tooltip
Bars and stoves cannot be placed on second story
Rival saloon will not work without owner
Fixed bug with provoke and family opinion increase.


More to come.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/b7cede3618e23afb4ccbef89513a69f31aa34472.png

New changes, fixes and updates. Thanks for feedback!


Tax System - new tax system that deducts tax at the beginning of each day based on past day's earnings. There are now three tax collectors in town - if they were to perhaps...disappear, the taxes would no longer be connected. As well, the Hotel and Townhall, both late game buildings, have options to lower tax rates if you wish to go the more legit route.

notes.title: What Kind Of Saloon Owner Will You Be?
notes.content:
The Choice Is Yours...

Whiskey drinking shit-kicker? Seductive charlatan? Studious or charismatic? Pious preacher? Ruthless manipulator?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/51cdb1e74601a32756d43563c801696011a1a97b.png

We like a wide range of possibilities, which is why we’ll let you decide how good-natured or rotten you wanna be. Just don’t come blaming us if you’re facing undesirable outcomes. You reap what you sow. And we believe in just desserts.

Not only will you get to name your Player Character, but also the Town, and your Saloon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/7de801560d520d3a98e029b1be7ef11fedf5d8d4.jpg

Here we have we have Franklin Mitchell, who will live in Bittervale. His outfit will be named Aces High Saloon. We’ve chosen a Handsome modifier, which gives a boost to two Attributes that may help him while he braves the frontier. Notice how his Savoir Faire and Seduction ratings are now at 30, while the rest remain at 10.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/39df777671352792cb8555bc65424642b4267897.jpg

Or would you rather be Captivating? With a boost to Drama and Leadership Attributes? It’s a tough call. Different Attributes will determine success in the face of different obstacles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/526c85bc40fb7b0910e8ec316b8b195f917f423c.jpg

Here we have Spring Thompson. We’ve selected the Compassionate modifier, which gives a boost to Medicine and Theology. Nothing like an amateur doctor with faith (Theology)! But also notice that we have now spent the Attribute Points. You start with 20, and can dispense them among the Attributes at will. So spend wisely. Here, Spring has an uptick in her Muscle rating (20), and Mixology (20). Why not have the capability to manhandle disruptive clientele and be better at mixing drinks?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/7ffca04c874508cb2542d75ca497979527b9fd26.jpg

And here, we’ve increased Spring’s age. Instantly, you are given more Attribute Points to spend, which we have used to uptick several more Attributes. Abstraction (20), Gambling (20), Savoir Faire (20). But also notice there’s a cost to Spring’s Health, which opens up a whole other set of circumstances and realities.

But we will save that for another time.

notes.title: Forging Your Way in the Wild West…
notes.content:
If like us, you’re lookin’ for an experience with the depth and sweeping grandeur of the wild west, while also havin’ a rootin-tootin good time, then grab the brandy and keep your rifles handy, 'cause we’re heading deep into the western frontier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/72107b950d9774193e7886e9aa12e95c6e6a235e.png

Not only will you build and manage your own outfit, but you will interact with staff, customers and townspeople of all walks and dispositions. Some will become your friends, perhaps even allies. Others will surely not. It won’t always be easy, but you will be able to take all kinds of matters into your own hands, or simply carry on and let things fester out of sight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/6e61da8b36b6a65245513fed178179746059030c.png

Be wary though, for bandits rove the countryside, and as the town grows, the encroaching eyes of the law are ever watchful. Consequences can be dire. Always remember; there are multiple ways to skin a cat. Not that we condone that kind of behaviour, only feel compelled to let you decide.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/3aa6bb6dc2eca538896ae16a60e0fca98071560f.png

Our Goal

We began work on Deadwater Saloon with a shared desire to play a management simulator in the wild west. Only, we had wishes to expand the traditional management sim to encompass a more immersive experience. We wanted to not only manage drinks, food, upkeep and decorum, but also a player character and their relationships, day to day struggles, and sanity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/c0060a995ebc28c155fd0ca93a132da251948355.png

We want the town to be a character unto itself. Settlers and townspeople will move into town, becoming affected and responding to your saloon and life choices. We are building a robust ecosystem within which to thrive and survive, or be overrun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371455/0d8fac20a3288505e586cf6a20f623d32990d4af.png

What has resulted is what we believe is an impactful experience. Not only with satisfying mechanics, but a satisfying emotional journey as well.

We can’t wait to continue sharing our development journey!
